company.name: Infisical
company.shortDescription: Infisical is an open-source secrets manager that secures and syncs app configs and credentials across teams with end-to-end encryption.
company.description: Infisical is an open-source platform that focuses on the secure management of application secrets, certificates, SSH keys, and configurations. It provides tools for teams to effectively manage sensitive information across various applications and environments. The platform features end-to-end encryption, ensuring that data remains protected during storage and transmission. Infisical also offers a user-friendly interface that simplifies the process of injecting secrets like API keys and database credentials into applications. Centralizing configuration management enhances collaboration among development teams and streamlines workflows, making it easier to maintain security and efficiency in software development.

productsAndServices.description: A centralized platform for storing, syncing, rotating, and auditing application secrets and configuration across environments, workloads, teams, and infrastructure.
productsAndServices.name: Secrets Management

productsAndServices.description: A platform for managing private certificate authorities and automating certificate discovery, issuance, renewal, revocation, deployment, and auditing.
productsAndServices.name: Certificate Management

productsAndServices.description: A privileged access platform that provides short-lived, identity-based access to infrastructure and databases with session auditing, recording, and automatic credential rotation.
productsAndServices.name: Privileged Access Management

productsAndServices.description: A credential-brokering product that lets AI agents access approved tools and APIs without exposing the underlying secrets to the agents.
productsAndServices.name: Agent Vault

productsAndServices.description: A secrets-scanning product that detects hardcoded credentials in source code and helps prevent them from being committed to version control systems.
productsAndServices.name: Infisical Radar

productsAndServices.description: A key management capability for controlling cryptographic keys used to protect secrets and other sensitive data within Infisical deployments.
productsAndServices.name: Key Management
